title: Spyglass is Officially Launched!
summary: Experience the full power of Spyglass as it officially graduates from beta, offering enhanced performance and a seamless user experience.

title: Advanced File Management in the Editor
summary: Take full control of your images, documents, and other files directly within the editor with new dedicated management options, allowing you to easily upload, remove, download, and customize how they appear.

title: See What's Next: Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to introduce a dedicated roadmap page where you can explore our latest achievements, see what's currently in progress, and discover what's coming next, providing full transparency into our product's evolution.

title: Enhanced Checklists
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved experience with our new checkboxes, now bigger, easier to interact with, and seamlessly draggable for efficient task organization.

title: Seamless Editor Collaboration
summary: Experience more intuitive and efficient teamwork with our enhanced editor collaboration, bringing clearer awareness and effortless real-time interaction.

title: Seamless Collaboration on Shared Ideas
summary: Users can now easily discover and interact with all relevant shared items, fostering seamless collaboration and shared progress.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: Enjoy Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out support for a wide range of international languages, making our platform accessible worldwide.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with greater control, transparency, and the opportunity to actively shape its future.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Navigate your entire knowledge base with unprecedented precision and discover deeper insights through powerful new filtering by tags, time, and shared connections.

title: Dynamic Search Filters & Curated Collections
summary: Discover exactly what you need with powerful new filters and save your refined searches as personalized collections for instant access.

title: Flexible Note Displays
summary: Experience a more intuitive and organized workflow as we introduce versatile new ways to display and interact with your linked notes.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: Soon, you'll gain the flexibility to self-host Noeko on your own infrastructure and access premium features through our brand-new tailored plans.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Fresh New Themes
summary: Get ready for a stunning visual upgrade with polished existing themes and a collection of brand-new styles designed to perfectly match your preferences.

title: Improved Daily Greetings
summary: Enjoy perfectly timed greetings on your homepage, making every visit feel more personal and welcoming.

title: Enhanced List Management & Bulk Actions
summary: Efficiently organize your content with powerful new bulk actions, allowing you to swiftly unapply tags and manage items directly from your lists, saving you valuable time and effort.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Get ready to effortlessly incorporate a wider variety of content, from YouTube videos and websites to text files, directly into your workspace.
